recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier horizontal composition featuring a central band portrait framed by thick black headers and footers containing contrasting typographic styles.
coreVisualRelationships: Central high-key portrait against dark outer bands
Geometric sans-serif top text vs. expressive script bottom text
Repetitive red dot border separating the image from the black frames
Cool-toned studio lighting on subjects against a warm-white vertical-slat background
coreInvariants: Thick black letterbox bars at top and bottom
White geometric sans-serif for the primary name
Red script for the secondary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects seated in modern white chairs, positioned mid-ground, filling the horizontal center third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast white chairs and the bright white background behind the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down: starts at the bold white name, moves to the central portrait, and settles on the red script at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space at the top and bottom edges creates a cinematic widescreen effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright center and dark edges; low saturation except for the vibrant red accents.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Uniform stroke width, circular 'O', sharp 'A' and 'N' vertices.
Bottom text: Fluid, connected script with varying stroke thickness and long flourishes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand in the script text is oversized and serves as a central flourish.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Structural contrast: Rigid, modern sans-serif paired with organic, traditional script.
graphicDevices: Vignetted edges on the central photo

avoid: Serif fonts for the top text

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura or ITC Avant Garde Gothic
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, circular 'O' and sharp 'A' of the top text.
Provides the necessary calligraphic flourishes and high contrast for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of four men in dark casual clothing (button-downs, hats, jeans) sitting in white modern plastic chairs. The background is a bright white wall with vertical texture. Add thick black bars at the top and bottom of the frame, separated from the photo by a thin line of red dots.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the band name in the top black bar using a white geometric sans-serif font, left-aligned. Add the album title in the bottom black bar using a red calligraphic script font, right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the top text all-caps and geometric?
Is the bottom text a red script?
Are there red dotted lines between the photo and the black bars?
Is the portrait high-contrast with white chairs?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for accents
Thickness of the black letterbox bars
Tracking of the top sans-serif text
mustRedesign: Original band name and album title text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red script is legible against the black background.
Verify the red dotted lines are consistent and straight.
Check that the subjects are properly centered in the middle third.
Confirm the top text is perfectly left-aligned with a small margin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Letterbox framing + Geometric Sans (Top Left) + Script (Bottom Right) + Red Dotted Accents + High-Key Studio Portrait.
